06 Brand Awareness

White Gold x Bigg Boss Agnipariksha

White Gold became the first brand in Telugu Bigg Boss history to get a direct entry slot into Agnipariksha for a common person. The catch: our Telugu Instagram page had 450 followers. I designed the contest with the Bigg Boss programming team, pushed for public posting over private uploads because that is what makes noise, and built a three-layer amplification plan on borrowed reach: Adi Reddy as the main channel, a network of Bigg Boss update pages, and story shares pulled forward from existing influencer contracts.
